title: RUST_CODE.BBS · The handles
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: The chorus has handles now: each stick figure with a word over its head in green — vagrant, cicada, moth, weir — and the strip draws the words as shapes and the figures acting them: one wanders, one sings, one circles the lamp, one dams the desk's pencil groove. Wood names none of them. They were named.

panels.composition: The desk. Four stick figures, each with a green word floating over it drawn as blocks.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, four tiny stick figures on a desk each with a small green block-word floating above it

panels.composition: One wandering off the desk's edge; one with its mouth open, singing lines.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, one tiny stick figure wandering off a desk's edge and another with its mouth open emitting small song lines

panels.composition: One circling the desk lamp's bulb; one building a tiny dam of eraser crumbs across the pencil groove.

characters.pose: one circling the lamp, one damming

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, one tiny stick figure circling a desk lamp's bulb and another building a tiny dam of eraser crumbs across a desk's pencil groove

panels.composition: WOOD watching. BARNABY's chin on the desk.

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it
